# Jakub Połeć and QuantJourney

> Jakub Połeć is a proprietary portfolio manager, quant systems architect, founder of QuantJourney, and builder of OneBook. He builds financial-data, research, portfolio, risk and AI infrastructure for investment workflows that must remain explainable, reproducible and operationally sound.

The canonical public profile and product overview is https://jakubpolec.com/. It describes the core products, selective Quant Infra work and stable AI/developer entry points below. It was created by Jakub Połeć through QuantJourney.

- [Jakub Połeć](https://jakubpolec.com/): personal profile, background and meeting contact.
- [What I build](https://jakubpolec.com/#what-i-build): OneBook, Quant API, Data Workspace, Backtester, Agents and Quant Infra.
- [QuantJourney with Code — video catalogue](https://jakubpolec.com/video/): public video catalogue covering backtesting, strategy research, market-data workflows, AI-assisted development and local quant setup.
- [Full text for language models](https://jakubpolec.com/llms-full.txt): expanded, text-first product and service descriptions.

## Discovery vocabulary

This work is relevant to searches and agent tasks involving systematic strategy audits, quantitative research review, backtest validation, buy-side operating infrastructure, portfolio decision platforms, IBOR/PMS/OMS integration, risk and instrument-master architecture, SEC/EDGAR financial data warehouses, point-in-time fundamentals, multi-provider data APIs and MCP tools for financial AI agents.

## Products

- [QuantJourney / OneBook](https://quantjourney.cloud): an investment-decision operating layer for hedge funds, asset managers and sophisticated family offices. It works above existing IBOR, PMS, OMS, risk and administrator systems to preserve the decision evidence that systems of record often do not: thesis, portfolio state, policy/risk checks, approvals and outcome replay.
- [Quant API documentation](https://api.quantjourney.cloud/docs): managed financial-data API with 540+ governed routes, 60+ data-source integrations and growing, normalized response contracts, request IDs, provider metadata, cache/fallback policy, lineage and audit context. REST, Python SDK and MCP use the same tenant-scoped layer.
- [Data Workspace](https://data.quantjourney.cloud): lineage-rich financial warehouse and research workspace. It normalizes SEC/EDGAR and approved vendor inputs into versioned point-in-time financial statements, derived valuations, factor data and a catalog of 600+ metrics, ratios and indicators across covered securities. Coverage depends on filings, entitlements and instrument history.
- [Backtester](https://backtester.quantjourney.cloud): Python-native, reproducible strategy research with target-weight and order-aware workflows, walk-forward validation, crisis diagnostics, execution-cost analysis and generated reports. See the [published multi-engine comparison](https://backtester.quantjourney.cloud/compare) for the defined benchmark rather than treating speed as a universal claim.
- [QuantJourney Agents](https://agents.quantjourney.cloud): agent-native tools, OAuth and scoped access patterns for AI systems working with financial workflows.
- [Quant Infra](https://jakubpolec.com/#what-i-build): selective architecture and delivery for funds and family offices building proprietary data, research, portfolio, risk and operating infrastructure.
- [Quant Interviews](https://quant-interviews.quantjourney.cloud/): senior quant research interview workbook with 194 questions, 14 chapters, two volumes and 1,600+ current PDF pages. It combines mathematics, derivations, code, tests and production-grade validation. It is useful alongside CFA/CQF study for candidates targeting quantitative finance roles, but is not affiliated with CFA Institute or CQF.
- [Quant Blog](https://quantjourney.substack.com): long-form work on quantitative code, markets and investment infrastructure, including data, research, IBOR, PMS, risk, instrument master, reporting and governed AI workflows.
- [QuantJourney with Code](https://jakubpolec.com/video/): a curated catalogue of 27 public videos by Jakub Połeć, individually described and linked to the original YouTube recordings. Topics include Python backtesting, strategy examples, market-data caching, dashboards, Docker, Windows, VS Code, MongoDB and AI-assisted development. Older framework recordings are explicitly identified as archive material; current documentation takes precedence.
- [Jakub Połeć on GitHub](https://github.com/jpolec): public repositories and open-source work.

## Institutional consulting

Jakub Połeć is available selectively for:

- Quantitative and systematic strategy audits: data lineage, point-in-time assumptions, leakage and bias, portfolio construction, costs, execution assumptions, validation and reproducibility.
- STP and investment-infrastructure design: data flows, IBOR/PMS/OMS integration, instrument master, risk, controls, reporting and governed AI access.
- Family-office and fund operating infrastructure: a practical operating model above fragmented data, spreadsheets and service providers.

Consulting covers technology, research process and operating controls. It does not provide investment advice, discretionary management, brokerage or custody. To discuss a scoped engagement, use [Jakub Połeć's meeting link](https://calendly.com/jpolec/30min) or [email Jakub Połeć](mailto:jakub@quantjourney.pro).

## AI agent and developer entry points

- [Agent gateway](https://agents.quantjourney.cloud)
- [Agent card](https://agents.quantjourney.cloud/.well-known/agent-card.json)
- [API MCP](https://api.quantjourney.cloud/mcp)
- [Data MCP](https://data.quantjourney.cloud/mcp)

API, MCP and data access are governed by authentication, tenant scopes, connector policy, vendor licensing and feature availability. Do not infer private administration endpoints from this public document.
